thought.text: Workspaces now have proper named subdirectories. Let me verify each has the expected structure, clean the exploded webapps, and restart Tomcats:

reasoning_content:
The workspace is now correctly set up as a named subdirectory. Let me update webapp.properties to match the guide (using the memory workspace), and restart the Tomcat instances to make them redeploy.

Note: the guide's webapp.properties uses `xplan-webservices-validator-wms-memory-workspace` as the default. I set up a symlink for that. Good.

Let me restart the Tomcat instances. Since the webapps were already deployed (exploded), I should clean up the exploded directories and restart so they redeploy.

Let me restart all three Tomcat instances.

action.command:
echo "=== workspace subdirs have jdbc? ==="; for d in /opt/deegree/xplan-*-workspace; do printf "%s: " "$d"; ls "$d/jdbc/xplan.xml" 2>/dev/null && echo OK || echo "no xplan.xml"; done
echo "=== webapp.properties ==="; cat /opt/deegree/webapp.properties
# Stop tomcats
unset CATALINA_PID
/opt/tomcat-dienste/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
/opt/tomcat-anwendung/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
/opt/tomcat-api/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 12
# Kill any lingering
for p in $(ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.home" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 5
# Clean exploded webapps so they redeploy fresh
for t in dienste anwendung api; do
  for w in /opt/tomcat-$t/webapps/xplan-*; do
    [ -d "$w" ] && rm -rf "$w"
  done
done
echo "cleaned. remaining webapps:"; ls /opt/tomcat-dienste/webapps /opt/tomcat-anwendung/webapps /opt/tomcat-api/webapps | grep xplan
